title: Wegleitung zur Steuererklärung für natürliche Personen 2025
why_needed: Main 2025 guide for natural persons: income, deductions, wealth, form codes, deadline, extension rules and filing channels.
notes: 48 pages, file dated 19 Nov 2025. States the 30 April 2026 deadline (p. 9), extension rules and fee, eTax.zug with AGOV login, signed Barcodeblatt for printed eTax returns, a Mustersteuererklärung (sample form K), a list of the main changes per 1 January 2025, and federal tariff notes (p. 47). Linked from zg.ch/de/steuern-finanzen/steuern/etax/formulare-np.

title: How to Fill in Your Zug Individual Tax Return [2025]
why_needed: Official English walkthrough for expats: form order (K, WV, BA, VZ), documents to attach and the 30 April deadline.
notes: 4 pages with annotated images of form K and the salary certificate. Not a full translation of the Wegleitung. Linked from the eTax.zug Instructions in English page. A second copy with identical text exists under jcr:047e591e (StKtZug_Wegleitung_Fremdsprache_2025_A4 FINAL.pdf); this URL is the newer file (modified Dec 2025).

title: Wertschriften- und Guthabenverzeichnis, Antrag Rückerstattung Verrechnungssteuer (WV), Steuererklärung 2025
why_needed: Securities and bank balances at 31 Dec 2025, withholding tax refund claim and partial taxation of dividends.
notes: 4 pages, form code WV, values at 31.12.2025, codes 600, 620, 621, 160, 115, 116, 410. Linked from zg.ch/de/steuern-finanzen/steuern/verrechnungssteuer/wertschriftenkontendevisen. The only 2025 schedule linked from a zg.ch page; blank K, BA, SV/VZ and KI forms for 2025 were not found online.

title: Zusammenzug Liegenschaftenverzeichnis (LVZ), Steuererklärung 2025
why_needed: Property summary schedule; only needed for owners of real estate.
notes: 4 pages, form code LVZ, Steuererklärung 2025. Found through a search engine, not linked from any zg.ch page read; zg.ch/dam redirects to this cdn.zg.ch URL.

title: Kantonssteuer «Grundtarif» gültig Steuerperiode 2026 (Grundtarif 2001 bis 2026)
publisher: Steuerverwaltung des Kantons Zug, Abteilung Natürliche Personen
why_needed: Indexed income and wealth brackets of the einfache Steuer for single filers; page 1 is 2026, page 2 is 2025.
notes: 8 pages, created 4 Dec 2025, one page per period back to 2001. Brackets are indexed yearly (StG § 45), so they differ from the amounts printed in StG § 35; use this file, not the law text, for the year's brackets. Header index labels differ slightly between pages (base Dec 2008 on 2026, Dec 2005 on 2025); check before relying on them. Linked from zg.ch/de/steuern-finanzen/steuern/natuerliche-personen/steuern-berechnen.

title: Kantonssteuer «Mehrpersonentarif» gültig Steuerperiode 2026 (Mehrpersonentarif 2001 bis 2026)
publisher: Steuerverwaltung des Kantons Zug, Abteilung Natürliche Personen
why_needed: Indexed income and wealth brackets for married couples and single parents (StG § 35 Abs. 2); page 1 is 2026, page 2 is 2025.
notes: 8 pages, created 4 Dec 2025. Zug uses a separate tariff with wider brackets for couples, not a splitting divisor. The 2026 page header cites the June 2024 index while the 2026 Grundtarif cites June 2025; check with the Steuerverwaltung. Periods up to 2023 are titled «Verheiratete».

title: Sozialabzüge Kantonssteuern gültig Steuerperiode 2026 (Sozialabzüge ab 2001 bis 2026)
publisher: Steuerverwaltung des Kantons Zug, Abteilung Natürliche Personen
why_needed: Indexed cantonal amounts per year: personal, child, pensioner, support, rent, self-care and childcare deductions, insurance deduction, second-earner deduction, wealth deductions and the capital-benefit threshold.
notes: 13 pages, created 4 Dec 2025; page 1 is 2026, page 2 is 2025, then earlier years. Covers StG § 33, § 30 Bst. g, h, l, § 44 and § 37 Abs. 2. The 2026 page reflects the «Mehrwert für alle» changes (insurance and pensioner deductions). Linked from zg.ch/de/steuern-finanzen/steuern/natuerliche-personen/steuerabzuege.

title: Steuerfüsse der Gemeinden des Kantons Zug für die Steuerjahre 2023 - 2026 in % der einfachen Steuer (100 %)
why_needed: Cantonal, communal (11 Einwohnergemeinden), Catholic and Reformed church and Bürgergemeinde multipliers for 2025 and 2026.
notes: 2 pages, created 20 Jan 2026, file name says effektiv 21.1.26. Multipliers are percentages of the einfache Steuer. Footnotes explain communal rebates, some as a percent of the multiplier and some as percentage points of the Einheitsansatz; the table prints the effective value. The printed title uses an en dash, replaced here by a hyphen.

title: Steuerfüsse der Gemeinden des Kantons Zug für die Steuerjahre 2022 - 2025 in % der einfachen Steuer (100 %)
why_needed: The 2025 edition of the multiplier table, kept as a cross-check for tax year 2025.
notes: 1 page, created 22 Jan 2025. The 2023 to 2026 file also covers 2025; compare the two before relying on a 2025 value. The printed title uses an en dash, replaced here by a hyphen.

title: Steuern für natürliche Personen berechnen
why_needed: Index page for the tariff PDFs; states that tariffs follow StG § 35 and are indexed yearly to the consumer price index.
notes: Links the Grundtarif and Mehrpersonentarif PDFs, the cantonal calculator (steuern.zg.ch/private/calculator, a JavaScript app) and the ESTV calculator. Use it to find moved tariff files.

title: Steuergesetz (BGS 632.1), Stand 1. Januar 2026
why_needed: Cantonal tax law in force from 1 Jan 2026: Steuerfuss (§ 2), deductions (§§ 25, 30, 31, 33), tariffs (§§ 35, 37, 44), indexation (§ 45), filing duties (§ 125).
notes: 132 pages. Current version per the BGS API (version id 2956, in force since 01.01.2026, decided 28.08.2025). § 2 Abs. 2b fixes the cantonal multiplier for 2026 to 2029. Bracket amounts in § 35 and § 44 are the unindexed legal base.

title: Steuergesetz (BGS 632.1), Stand 1. Januar 2024
why_needed: Version of the tax law that governs tax year 2025.
notes: 132 pages. BGS version id 2510, in force 01.01.2024 to 31.12.2025 (decided 06.07.2023). This is the version linked from zg.ch/de/steuern-finanzen/steuern/steuerrecht-und-steuergesetz/steuergesetz.

title: Verordnung zum Steuergesetz (BGS 632.11), Stand 1. Januar 2022
why_needed: Implementing ordinance of the tax law (for example § 10 on professional costs), in force for 2025 and 2026.
notes: 21 pages. BGS version id 2286, in force since 01.01.2022 (decided 04.05.2021); no newer or future version listed by the BGS API on 13 Oct 2026.

title: Verordnung über die elektronische Einreichung der Steuererklärung (VES), BGS 632.12, Stand 1. Januar 2026
why_needed: Legal rules for e-filing: eTax.zug or a recognised solution only, AGOV login, access data, 120 hour correction window, when the deadline counts as met, sharing with representatives.
notes: 7 pages, decided 11 March 2025, in force 1 Jan 2026 (GS 2025/011), first applies to tax period 2025. § 3: e-filing only with eTax.zug or another solution recognised by the Steuerverwaltung and listed on its website. § 6 Abs. 4: deadline met if the second email shows forwarding on the last day of the deadline.

title: eTax.zug
why_needed: Official hub for the online return from tax period 2025: AGOV registration, filling, submission, extension, support, downloads.
notes: States that from tax period 2025 the return can be done fully online; older periods use the old download solution. Links etax.zg.ch (redirects to the AGOV login), Instructions in English, the NP guide page and the 2022 to 2024 downloads.

title: 3. Steuererklärung einreichen
why_needed: Submission steps, the 5 day correction window, email confirmations and the two paper routes.
notes: Submission type defaults to Online einreichen; switching to print and post is possible. After online submission, send no paper documents.

title: Fristerstreckung Steuererklärung natürliche Personen
publisher: Steuerverwaltung des Kantons Zug, Abteilung Natürliche Personen
why_needed: Filing deadline of 30 April, online extension request, the 31 December limit and the fee for longer extensions.
notes: The online form itself (steuern.zg.ch/private/fristerstreckung) is a JavaScript app and needs the Pers ID. Matches the Wegleitung 2025 p. 9.

title: Fragen und Antworten aus dem Webinar zum neuen eTax.zug vom 19. März 2026
why_needed: Official answers on eTax.zug: e-tax statement (eSteuerauszug) upload, previous-year import, Dr.Tax import, sharing with a fiduciary, German-only interface, no mixed paper and online filing.
notes: 6 pages, created 23 March 2026. Linked from zg.ch/de/steuern-finanzen/steuern/etax/webinar26. Answers to webinar participants; the VES ordinance is the binding text.

title: Webinar neues eTax.zug vom 19. März 2026
why_needed: Names the eTax.zug support vendor, describes prerequisites and states that couples need no signature online (joint access code).
notes: 34 slides, created 20 March 2026. Slide 26: technical support is run on the canton's behalf by Callpoint AG (AGOV) and Ringler Informatik AG (eTax.zug). Slide 33 cites § 2 Abs. 2 VES for couples.

title: Steuererklärung 2025 ab Februar 2026 komplett online ausfüllen
why_needed: Announces the browser-based eTax.zug replacing the downloadable software, dispatch dates, AGOV login and that paper stays allowed.
notes: Returns sent from 24 Feb 2026 to individuals. Data stored only on cantonal servers. Says eTax.zug builds on a standardised solution already used in other cantons, and that from tax year 2026 previous-year data is taken over automatically online.

title: Quellensteuertarife
publisher: Steuerverwaltung des Kantons Zug, Gruppe Quellensteuer
why_needed: Index of the 2026 source tax tariff PDFs and of the 2023 to 2025 archives.
notes: 2026 files: AN, AY, BN, BY, CN, CY, HN, HY and G (N without, Y with church tax). The 2025 tariffs are on the sub-page publikationen-2025.

title: Quellensteuer für ausländische Arbeitnehmer/Innen, Monatstarif für Alleinstehende (Tarif AN), gültig ab 01.01.2026
publisher: Steuerverwaltung des Kantons Zug, Gruppe Quellensteuer
why_needed: Monthly source tax tariff A without church tax for 2026, codes A0N to A5N and beyond.
notes: 35 pages, created 25 Nov 2025. Other codes are separate PDFs on the Quellensteuertarife page.

title: Quellensteuer für ausländische Arbeitnehmer/Innen, Monatstarif für Alleinstehende (Tarif AN), gültig ab 01.01.2025
publisher: Steuerverwaltung des Kantons Zug, Gruppe Quellensteuer
why_needed: Monthly source tax tariff A without church tax for 2025.
notes: 35 pages, created 5 Nov 2024. Linked from zg.ch/de/steuern-finanzen/steuern/quellensteuer/quellensteuertarife/publikationen-2025, which also lists AY, BN, BY, CN, HN, HY and G for 2025.

title: Antrag auf nachträgliche ordentliche Veranlagung (NOV)
why_needed: NOV request form (Art. 89, 89a, 99a DBG) with its 31 March deadline and once-only rule for Swiss residents.
notes: 1 page, form 250, year field left blank. The 2025 file (jcr:a827b394, 2025_form_250_NOV_Antrag_def.29.10.24.pdf) is byte-identical, so the form is year-independent. Linked from zg.ch/de/steuern-finanzen/steuern/quellensteuer/quellensteuerpflichtige-person.

title: Anhang II, Übersicht über die nachträgliche ordentliche Veranlagung (NOV)
why_needed: One-page table of mandatory and optional NOV cases, deadlines, consequences and competent canton.
notes: 1 page, info 250, created 26 Nov 2025. Thresholds are in the document.

title: Antrag auf Neuberechnung der Quellensteuer
why_needed: Source tax correction request (wrong gross wage, rate-determining income or tariff code) and its non-extendable 31 March deadline.
notes: 1 page, form 255. The 2025 file (jcr:a374a5df) is byte-identical. Lists required attachments.

title: Übersicht über die Grundlagen für die Berechnung der Quellensteuertarife der Bundes-, Kantons- & Gemeindesteuer
why_needed: Flat deductions built into the 2026 source tax tariffs per code; shows what an NOV can add on top.
notes: 1 page, file dated 9 Dec 2025. Link label on the zg.ch page: Merkblatt QST Pauschalabzüge Tarife. The 2025 edition link (jcr:3267b44d) returned 404.

title: Steuerbuch
why_needed: Table of contents of the Zug Steuerbuch, the administration's practice notes ordered by StG paragraph.
notes: Book last modified 6 Jan 2026. The page lists chapter titles but its links are built by JavaScript; chapter and section URLs follow wissen.zg.ch/steuerbuch/<chapter>/<section>. The PDF export is generated on demand and has no stable URL.

title: 16.1 Grundsätzliches und Höhe der Abzüge
why_needed: States that the flat rates in the annex of the federal professional-costs ordinance (SR 642.118.1) also apply to cantonal and communal tax.
notes: Steuerbuch chapter 16 (StG § 25, VO StG § 10), section modified 4 Nov 2025. The URL slug says selbstaendiger but the chapter covers employees (unselbständige Erwerbstätigkeit). Meals, weekly stay and other costs are in sections 16.3 to 16.5.

title: 16.2.1 Grundsätzliches zu Fahrkosten zum Arbeitsort
why_needed: Commuting cost caps, which differ between the cantonal tax and the federal tax, with the federal cap per year including 2025 and 2026.
notes: Modified 19 Jan 2026. Public transport versus private car rules are in 16.2.2 and 16.2.3 (car only if public transport is unavailable or unreasonable; 220 working days).

title: 20.10.1.2 Kantonssteuer (ab Steuerperiode 2024)
why_needed: Cantonal childcare cost deduction (§ 30 Bst. l StG) cap per child for 2024, 2025 and 2026.
notes: Modified 19 Jan 2026. Conditions, eligible costs and proof are in sections 20.10.2 to 20.10.6; the federal rule is in 20.10.1.1.

title: 21.1 Abzug von Krankheits- und Unfallkosten
why_needed: Medical cost deduction rules (§ 31 Bst. a StG): uncapped, above a share of net income, aligned with the federal rule.
notes: Modified 4 Nov 2025. Refers to ESTV Kreisschreiben Nr. 11 for details and notes the diabetes and coeliac changes since 2023.

title: 22.8 Eigenbetreuungskostenabzug Steuerperiode (2013 - 2025)
why_needed: Zug-specific deduction for children cared for at home (§ 33 Abs. 2 StG), its conditions and that it cannot be combined with the childcare deduction.
notes: Modified 19 Jan 2026. The heading says 2013 to 2025 but the text gives amounts for 2025 and 2026.

title: Steuergesetzänderung «Mehrwert für alle» angenommen
why_needed: Confirms the 30 Nov 2025 vote: temporary cut of the cantonal multiplier for 2026 to 2029, higher insurance-premium deductions and a wider pensioner deduction.
notes: Medienmitteilung of 30 Nov 2025. Pointer only; the amounts are in StG Stand 1.1.2026 and the Sozialabzüge PDF.

title: Kantonale Volksabstimmung vom 30. November 2025: Änderung des Steuergesetzes vom 28. August 2025 «Mehrwert für alle»
why_needed: Official explanation and synopsis of the 2026 changes (cantonal multiplier 2026 to 2029, insurance-premium deduction, pensioner deduction).
notes: 24 pages, created 25 Sep 2025, title from the PDF metadata. Pages 16 onward compare the old and new law text. Accepted at the vote of 30 Nov 2025; the consolidated law Stand 1.1.2026 is the binding text.
